gaps.gap: Only K50-B1 has a real full-training-step speedup; TFC/DFC/CGC/KFC/AGS are renderer-local (frozen PLY) and MUST NOT be presented as training speedups.
No method has a measured TOTAL-training-time speedup end-to-end (only per-iter / renderer-step). K50-B1 implies it but no separate total-time field.
K50-B1: single seed, no multi-seed CI; LPIPS not measured; stage4a config-buggy 5K cohort.
DFC: >=1.2x E2E gate fails on dense scenes (garden 1.140x, bicycle 1.061x); O(N) projection dominates 39-50% of budget; no transmittance headroom. Room pass marginal (4/8 cams).
VOS: Amdahl-bound (optimizer ~15% of wall, SparseGaussianAdam O(N)); no wall-clock speedup; room seed-0 instability (-0.271 dB).
CGC: fidelity gates (SSIM/grad-cos/LPIPS) fail at every threshold on every scene; rasterize kernel overhead-bound; no trained ckpt for garden/bicycle.
KFC: fused kernel cannot launch on real workload (804KB shared >> 164KB A100 max); bwd compute-bound; autograd boundary blocks E2E; KFC0 DRAM claim disproven.
AGS: 0% tile reuse (Jaccard ~0.001); incremental repair 2.18x slower than radix; garden/bicycle ckpts missing.
IGF: no CUDA kernel (pure-PyTorch sparse step slower end-to-end); quality/economic tension; importance model does not transfer across scene complexity.
Single hardware cohort (EPIC-05 A100 remote-only); no cross-GPU / cross-vendor validation.
TFC2 grad_cosine>=0.99999 self-imposed proxy gate at CUDA noise floor (documented, not a regression); full-convergence evidence absent.
DFC1-R1 saved-T backward fix validated but is a no-op at early-termination thresholds and delivers no standalone speedup (SUPPORTING only).
Historical failed/superseded gates must be preserved in the paper (KFC0/AGS0/CGC0/IGF0/DFC0/VOS0/TFC0) - do not silently drop.
